text: Our cities woke to explosions today. Some people are in shelters. Others are already helping their neighbours. The government is working. We are staying here.
Bondarenko reporting. We are getting people into shelters. The troops are asking for orders.
Our reserve is a dragon. Guide him, destroy enemy aircraft and survive each wave. Together, we will free our land, one mission at a time.
A dragon? All right. How do I get him to listen?
Steer with the left joystick and hold the fire button on the right. You can move and shoot at the same time.
Shoot down missiles with fire, too. In the campaign, destroying enemies and missiles earns experience. Each new player level gives you one crystal.
So the better we defend the sky, the stronger our partner can become?
Yes. Spend crystals in Upgrade on the dragon’s health, faster or larger fireballs, or a shorter reload time.
Understood. Meet me by the hangar in Pechersk. Time to get to know our new partner.
